about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover SDV6 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover SDV6 has been part of the Range Rover line-up since the L322 generation, spanning two generations under one engine badge. Both the L322 (2001–2012) and L405 (2012–2021) use the 4.4-litre TDV8/SDV8 diesel V8 — a sibling engine family to the TDV6/SDV6, sharing the same timing chain and injector wear patterns. The engine was discontinued with the arrival of the L460 generation, which replaced it with Ingenium diesel and BMW-sourced V8 units.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace TDV8/SDV8 engines for every Range Rover SDV6 on the road.

codes.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover SDV6 ENGINE

cards.body: A 4.4-litre V8 diesel fitted to the Range Rover SDV6 from 2001 to 2021 across two generations. Known for timing chain and injector wear over time — see the callout above. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR, turbo and gaskets as standard on every TDV8/SDV8 rebuild.

compatibility.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover SDV6 ENGINE
compatibility.intro: Because the Range Rover SDV6 runs the same TDV8/SDV8 engine family across both generations, compatibility comes down to generation-specific ancillaries and ECU configurations rather than a different engine code. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (TDV8/SDV8) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
